cohort: A register-based national cohort of all women born in Sweden between 1973 and 1977 (N=175821) whose 343828 livebirths between 1986-2012 were identified.
finding: Women who experienced out-of-home care in childhood had an increased risk of preterm delivery for their subsequent offspring, independent of their own perinatal history.
followup_time: Up to 39 years after the women's own birth
